run_doxygen_compound_listing_tests: run the Listing test class to verify doxygen XML to HTML rendering for index pages, directories, files, namespaces, classes, and pages
run_doxygen_detailed_tests: run the Detailed test class to verify doxygen HTML generation for namespaces, class templates, functions, enums, typedefs, variables, and defines
run_doxygen_ignored_tests: run the Ignored test class to verify that private classes, undocumented files, and hidden namespaces are excluded from generated HTML output
run_doxygen_modules_tests: run the Modules test class to verify doxygen module and subgroup HTML generation including modules.html and group pages
run_doxygen_deprecated_tests: run the Deprecated test class to verify that deprecated labels appear correctly across class trees, namespaces, files, directories, and modules
